description: Energyscape 2 - Comparing stated preferences of renewable energy landscapes in Switzerland in 2018 and 2022 is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. This repository presents the basis data of both the Energyscape 1 (2018) and the Energyscape 2 (2022) survey about renewable energy infrastructure related landscape preferences in Switzerland. Both datasets are based on Swiss-national representatative online panel surveys (BILENDI). Information about the choice design and landscape visualizations can be derived from. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
